source_snapshot.title: The Scrum Guide (November 2020) — selected Product Owner and Product Goal passages
facts: The Product Owner is accountable for maximizing product value.
Product Backlog management includes communicating the Product Goal and ordering items.
The Product Goal describes a future product state.

source_facts.text: The Product Owner is accountable for maximizing product value.
Product Backlog management includes communicating the Product Goal and ordering items.
The Product Goal describes a future product state.

evidence_references.text_reference: maximizing the value of the product
Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal

learning_objectives: 用自己的語言說明 Product Owner 對最大化產品價值及 Product Backlog management 的 accountability。
解釋 Product Goal 如何描述未來狀態，並作為 Product Backlog 演進與規劃的目標。
以來源 evidence 區分 Scrum Guide 明確陳述與個人情境推論。
concepts: Product Owner accountability：可委派工作，但 accountability 仍由 Product Owner 承擔。
Product Backlog management：包括 Product Goal、清楚溝通 backlog items、排序，以及保持透明、可見、可理解。
Product Goal：Product Backlog 的 commitment；描述產品未來狀態，供 Scrum Team 規劃。
definitions: Product Goal（意譯）：Scrum Team 的長期目標，描述產品未來狀態，供團隊規劃；完成或放棄一個目標後才轉向下一個。
Product Backlog（意譯）：為改善產品所需工作的持續演進、有序清單，也是 Scrum Team 所承擔工作的單一來源。
examples: Illustrative scenario (not a Guide fact): a team reorders two backlog items after learning that one better supports its current Product Goal; explain the trade-off and make the ordering rationale visible.
misconceptions: 誤解：Product Owner 必須親自完成所有 backlog 管理工作。修正：部分工作可委派，但 accountability 不轉移。
誤解：Product Goal 是 Sprint Goal 的別名。修正：兩者時間範圍與所屬 artifact commitment 不同。
誤解：Product Owner 是由多位 stakeholder 組成的 committee。修正：Scrum Guide 將其定義為一個人，可代表多方需要。
question_seeds: 你會用哪些可觀察 evidence 判斷一個 backlog 順序是否支援現行 Product Goal？
哪些 Product Backlog 工作可委派，哪些 accountability 仍不能委派？
若新資訊令原 Product Goal 不再有價值，團隊應如何檢視與調整？請指出需要核對的 Scrum Guide 段落。
derived_analysis.difficulty_suggestion: Foundational to intermediate; focus on applying accountabilities and artifact commitments, not memorizing exam answers.
review_focus: 逐項核對 source_facts 與 Scrum Guide 原文；definitions 是中文意譯，不是逐字引文。
確認 illustrative scenario 被標示為教學推演，不是 Guide 案例。
對照 Scrum.org 最新公開 PSPO I learning objectives 前，勿把本包視為完整 assessment blueprint。
unknowns: 本包只涵蓋 Scrum Guide 中與 Product Owner／Product Goal 相關的選段，並非完整 PSPO I 課程或考試範圍。
沒有使用、重製或推測任何受保護考題；question seeds 是自編開放式學習提示。
Scrum Guide 為 November 2020 版本；若官方發布新版，需重新核對內容與引用。
